exposure: Mothers who delivered via Caesarean section
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section, home delivery)
cohort: 1982 weighted samples of mothers with children aged under 24 months in Ethiopia
finding: Late breastfeeding initiation practice is prevalent (26.4%) in Ethiopia, with young maternal age, no antenatal care visits, Caesarean section delivery, and home delivery being significant determinants.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was found to be a significant determinant of late initiation of breastfeeding.
